import json
import yt_dlp
from datetime import datetime
import time

# Get RSS dates
import urllib.request
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

RSS_URL = 'https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=UCX6OQ3DkcsbYNE6H8uQQuVA'
tree = ET.parse(urllib.request.urlopen(RSS_URL))
root = tree.getroot()
ns = {'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom'}

rss_dates = {}
for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
    video_id = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text.replace('yt:video:', '')
    published = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
    rss_dates[video_id] = published

print(f'Got {len(rss_dates)} dates from RSS')

# Get flat playlist info (IDs + duration)
ydl_opts = {
    'skip_download': True,
    'extract_flat': 'in_playlist',
    'playlistend': 800,
    'quiet': True,
    'no_warnings': True,
}

videos = []
with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
    info = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/@MrBeast/videos', download=False)
    if 'entries' in info:
        for entry in info['entries']:
            vid_id = entry.get('id', '')
            title = entry.get('title', '')
            duration = entry.get('duration', 0)
            upload_date = rss_dates.get(vid_id, '')
            videos.append({
                'id': vid_id,
                'title': title,
                'duration': duration,
                'upload_date': upload_date
            })

print(f'Got {len(videos)} videos total')
for v in videos[:5]:
    print(f"  {v['id'][:10]}: dur={v['duration']}, date='{v['upload_date']}'")

# Fetch remaining upload dates for videos not in RSS
batch_start = 20  # RSS has 15, start from 20
missing = 0
for i in range(batch_start, len(videos)):
    vid = videos[i]
    if not vid['upload_date']:
        vid_id = vid['id']
        try:
            ydl_opts2 = {
                'skip_download': True,
                'quiet': True,
                'no_warnings': True,
                'extract_flat': False,
                'playlistend': 1,
            }
            with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts2) as ydl2:
                info2 = ydl2.extract_info(f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid_id}', download=False)
                date = info2.get('upload_date', '')
                videos[i]['upload_date'] = date
        except:
            videos[i]['upload_date'] = '00000000'
        missing += 1
        if missing % 20 == 0:
            print(f'  Fetched {missing} missing dates...')

with open('/app/all_videos.json', 'w') as f:
    json.dump(videos, f, indent=2)

print(f'Total videos: {len(videos)}')
print(f'Videos with dates: {sum(1 for v in videos if v["upload_date"])}')
PYEOF

            })

print(f'Got {len(flat_videos)} videos from flat playlist', file=sys.stderr)

print(f'Got {len(rss_dates)} dates from RSS', file=sys.stderr)

# Initialize results
results = []
for v in flat_videos:
    vid_id = v['id']
    results.append({
        'id': vid_id,
        'title': v['title'],
        'duration': v['duration'],
        'upload_date': rss_dates.get(vid_id, ''),

# Step 3: Fetch remaining dates in parallel

    try:

print(f'Step 4: Writing results ({len(results)} videos)', file=sys.stderr)
with open('/app/all_videos.json', 'w') as f:

# Summary
